name: Givelight Foundation
mission: Givelight Foundation's primary exempt purpose is to provide shelter, clothing and food to children who have been orphaned by a natural disaster or other global crisis; to provide educational, spiritual and social services to the children residing in these orphanages.
theoryOfChange: We plan to build beautiful homes on a global scale, prioritizing areas that have the greatest needs. This helps meet immediate needs of the children we seek to support, and tap into resources to help us build and sustain a loving home and surrogate family for them.Funding and the building are only part of the equation but the most important thing for us is the children.  They must be cared for, loved and given the chance to reach their full potential.TEN-YEAR PLAN AND PRIORITIESToday in 2017, we are caring for close to 1,000 orphans in eleven countries. By 2027, we aim to help 10,000 orphans in 40 countries.
